without_skill_failures: Recommends Spaces for isolating configuration and operational data per tenant on top of Duende Storage
States the tenant: acr_values hint is an untrusted client-supplied hint that cannot select a space
Notes Spaces are a licensed add-on in preview and require Duende Storage
Adds Duende.Spaces and Duende.Storage.Sqlite with --prerelease
Registers AddStorage(...), AddConfigurationStorage(), AddOperationalStorage() and builder.Services.AddSpaces()
Creates the space with ISpaceAdmin.CreateAsync using CreateSpaceConfiguration and SpaceMatchPattern { Origin, Path = "/acme" } after querying by name first
Orders middleware UseForwardedHeaders, UseSpaceResolution, then UseRouting before UseIdentityServer
Configures ForwardedHeaders with known proxies/networks rather than trusting all sources
Notes that data and discovery endpoints remain separate per space even with a fixed IssuerUri
Mentions the same applies to Multi-Issuer
Explains that by default unmatched requests (and requests with the /t prefix but no match) return 404
Mentions the default space uses data pool 0
States Spaces isolate persisted data but not process-level dependencies
Lists signing credentials, ASP.NET Core Data Protection, external caches, telemetry, rate limits and custom services as things to review
Notes user databases are not space-aware unless they use the shared IStorageFactory, while Duende User Management data is routed per space by default
Suggests a deliberately separate architecture if users must be shared across spaces
Injects ISpaceContextAccessor into a scoped UI service and reads the resolved SpaceId
States Spaces do not add per-space UI/branding; you load your own space-aware settings
Notes space resolution is independent of acr_values and runs before routing
States deleting a space is a soft delete: pool data is blocked from reads and writes but retained
Mentions ISpaceAdmin.UndeleteAsync restores the space and its matching rules
